skirmish.module.effect_hud.name: Effects
skirmish.module.effect_hud.description: Your active effects: icon, level and time left.
skirmish.module.effect_hud.setting.hide_: Remove the effect icons in the top-right corner (the inventory still shows them)
skirmish.module.effect_hud.setting.show_: Show ambient effects from beacons and similar sources
skirmish.module.effect_hud.setting.warn_: The time is highlighted when less than this is left (0 turns it off)
skirmish.module.armor_hud.name: Armor
skirmish.module.armor_hud.description: Durability of your armor and held items. Your own items only.
skirmish.module.armor_hud.setting.show_h: Show the main and off hand next to the armor
skirmish.module.armor_hud.setting.warn_p: Below this the durability turns red, below twice this yellow
